The '''Intelligence Bureau''' was a part of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] that would take the data from the [[Analysis Bureau (Imperial Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau]] and run it by a group of experts to predict what the Empire's enemies would do next.

==External Communications==
{{Main|External Communications}}
ExComm relayed messages between the various branches of Imperial Intelligence, the [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]], and the Imperial military.

==Sector branches==
{{Main|Sector branch}}
These branches were specifically assigned to perform intelligence activities in their designated [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

==Sedition==
{{Main|Sedition}}
This branch predicted trends of groups that offered resistance to the Empire.

==Crisis==
{{Main|Crisis}}
This branch was formed in times of crisis out of experts from the other branches. It would be under the control of the Ubiqtorate, but could also answer to a [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] or the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] himself.
